Healthcare / Campus Planning · Shillong, Meghalaya

Shillong Healthcare Campuses

A group of proposals for Civil Hospital, Red Cross accommodation and Ganesh Das Hospital. The work covers campus reorganisation, clinical blocks, staff housing and the relationship between hospital buildings and restorative outdoor spaces.

Location
Shillong, Meghalaya
Category
Healthcare / Campus Planning
Design role
Ola Magdy, Principal Associate Designer
Practice
Archohm
01

Civil Hospital campus

The redevelopment study reorganises clinical and supporting functions within the existing campus.

02

Oncology block

The building studies coordinate clinical floors with circulation, services and the hospital section.

Drawings & studies
03

Operating theatre block

The OT and ICU studies document the stacked clinical programme and its structural organisation.

Drawings & studies
04

Red Cross accommodation

A separate accommodation proposal combines residential floors with a raised building form and shared access.

Drawings & studies
05

Ganesh Das Hospital

The masterplan study considers retained buildings, new development and internal movement across the hospital site.
